# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 107 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 107 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_107_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — Rock and Water Are One

**1** I asked him about the time element, and also why the tower was built not on flat ground but on a rock set in water. **2** "You're asking exactly the right question about the foundation," he said. **3** When I pressed for the reason it was built on water, he replied: "I told you already — but you're still asking. It's a good question; listen carefully. **4** The rock and the water are one and the same reality. The rock is the Son of God. He existed before everything was made, and he revealed himself in these final days of this present age. **5** Water also existed before everything — and that is precisely why water is used for cleansing and for entering eternal life. The very earth was brought into being through water. **6** So the rock is ancient, and the water is new — yet through baptism people enter God's kingdom and are purified from sin and contamination, through the name of the Son of God. **7** The rock and the water are one — inseparable. To come to God you must pass through both: water for purification, the rock for an unshakeable foundation. **8** There is one foundation of all life, and it is the Son of God.'"

---

*PNEUMA renders the rock-water unity with clarity and concludes with the climactic confession: the Son of God is the single foundation of all life.*
